question: What should one contemplate after accomplishing worship of the body?
premises: Worship accomplishes a transformation of the body.
One should contemplate the body as of Shiva-nature.
Outward turning to objects and limitation dissolve.
inference: After worship, contemplation should recognize the body as Shiva-nature once limitation and outwardness have dissolved.
plain_english: Having accomplished the body through worship, one should contemplate it as of Shiva-nature. When outward turning toward objects has dissolved and limitation has melted away, this contemplation becomes clear.
